newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber futures start higher then parge gains.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber futures start higher then parge gains.

text.p: CME lumber futures started higher on carryover demand but prices slipped as commercial hedge interest developed, traders said.

Carryover demand from Wednesday's gains boosted prices at the start but demand eased and prices slipped back as light commercial hedge selling entered the market despite the sharp discount of futures to cash, they said.
Futures still appear to be consolidating on the charts in the $340 to $360 per tbf range, they added.
At 0945 CDT, lumber stood $2.20 to $5.00 per tbf higher with November up the least at $352.00 per tbf.
